a remembrance mass for missing people, and their families will be held in st. mary's church, sandyford, dublin, d18e5r3, on saturday, 10 october 2026 at 2.30pm. the mass will be celebrated by father aquinas duffy. this is a poignant ceremony to pray for missing people, and for comfort and strength for families, and to guide all search efforts towards their successful return. prayers will also be offered for irish people missing abroad and for an end to the sufferings of these families.
